create_udop_tokenizer: create a UdopTokenizer instance backed by a Unigram tokenizer for document understanding tasks
encode_document_with_boxes: encode pretokenized document text with word-level bounding boxes and optional word labels
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build model inputs from a sequence or pair of sequences by concatenating and adding special tokens
pad_encoded_inputs: pad encoded token inputs to a specified maximum length on the left or right side
tokenize_document_text: tokenize a single document text string into a list of token strings with optional pair
